headline: Pochettino quits USMNT after the Haiti tie to take over Manchester United
facts: Pochettino's last USMNT game was a 2-0 win over Haiti in Cincinnati, 8-0 on aggregate in the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal.
Pulisic scored a bicycle kick and Julian Hall added a second just before halftime.
He left less than three months after signing a new US Soccer contract; United announced him on 13 November a day after sacking Michael Carrick.
Half of his staff, including assistant Jesus Perez, went to Manchester after the first leg.
background: Pochettino has previously managed Tottenham, Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea; the article says no full-time USMNT coach in the modern era had left of his own accord before him.
footage_terms: Pochettino Manchester United announced press conference

headline: US Soccer scrambles for a new coach as Emma Hayes joins the hiring committee and Arena says they have no clue
facts: USWNT coach Emma Hayes will act as a technical advisor in the search for Pochettino's successor.
CEO J.T. Batson and COO Dan Helfrich lead the search; Pep Guardiola is seen as an obvious but uncertain target while on sabbatical.
U23 coach Steve Cherundolo will run the 13 December friendly against Jamaica meanwhile.
Former US coach Bruce Arena (San Jose boss) said the federation does not have a clue what it is doing, per ESPN on 18 November.
background: Arena coached the US national team in two separate spells and now manages the San Jose Earthquakes.

headline: Ronaldo retires from Portugal after walking out on Jorge Jesus
facts: Ronaldo announced his Portugal retirement on 5 November after a fallout with coach Jorge Jesus over limited minutes in the Nations League.
He left camp by private jet in protest and was given a 30-day suspension and a small fine.
He finishes with 146 international goals and 234 caps, both records; Messi is second in each.
Spain eliminated Portugal in his last World Cup in 2026.
background: Ronaldo debuted for Portugal in 2003 and captained them to the Euro 2016 title, but never won a World Cup.

headline: Portugal win first game of the post-Ronaldo era as Carlos Forbs takes the No. 7 shirt and scores
facts: Portugal beat Wales 3-2 in Cardiff in the Nations League.
Forbs scored the 70th-minute winner, his first international goal, wearing Ronaldo's No. 7 with a line across it as a tribute.
Portugal won the group with five wins from six but lost 4-1 to Denmark the previous Saturday.
They await a March quarterfinal against a runner-up; Netherlands were drawn on 20 November.
background: Ronaldo made the No. 7 shirt famous with Portugal; Forbs scored his first international goal in it twelve days after Ronaldo announced his retirement.

headline: Scaloni signs new Argentina deal through the 2030 World Cup
facts: Scaloni's deal, due to end in 2026, now runs through the 2030 World Cup.
He will become the first Argentina coach to lead the team at three World Cups.
Record in 107 matches: 79 wins, 18 draws, 10 defeats.
He plans to give more responsibility to Nico Paz, Franco Mastantuono, Valentin Barco, Matias Soule and Gianluca Prestianni.
background: Under Scaloni Argentina won the 2022 World Cup, two Copa America titles and the Finalissima, then lost the 2026 final to Spain.

headline: Argentina lose 2-1 to Uruguay in first match after Messi's retirement, No. 10 shirt left empty
facts: Uruguay won 2-1 at La Bombonera: Balerdi own goal (48'), Maxi Araujo (53'), Julian Alvarez pulled one back (73').
It was Argentina's first match since Messi retired from internationals in early October.
The stadium was not a sellout, unusual for Argentina.
Scaloni left Messi's No. 10 unassigned and said he has not chosen a successor.
background: Messi played his last international on 6 October against Benin, his 208th cap, scoring his 126th goal; Uruguay were coached by Diego Forlan, the former Uruguay striker.

headline: Argentina hammer Costa Rica 7-0 with doubles from Paz, Alvarez and Mastantuono
facts: Argentina won 7-0 in Cordoba, three days after losing to Uruguay.
Paz (8', 38'), Alvarez (35', 43') and Mastantuono (48', 88') scored two each; Mac Allister added one.
Argentina led 4-0 at halftime.
Paz has scored in four of his last five national-team games, Alvarez in his last four.
background: Argentina lost the 2026 World Cup final to Spain 1-0 after extra time and are in their first year without Lionel Messi.

headline: Nico Paz, Como's heir to Messi's No. 10, whose Real Madrid price tag jumped from 6 to 60 million
facts: Paz left Real Madrid for Como in 2024 for about 6 million euros with buy-back clauses.
This summer Madrid let Como take full rights for about 60 million euros but can re-sign him in 2027 for 80 million.
He has 25 goals and 25 assists in 89 games under Cesc Fabregas, including a brace in a 4-1 Champions League win over Manchester United.
He now wears Messi's old Argentina No. 10 and plays on the right wing.
background: Paz was born in Tenerife and is the son of Pablo Paz, who played for Argentina at the 1998 World Cup.
footage_terms: Como Manchester United 4-1 Champions League Paz

headline: Japan beat Brazil 3-2 in Singapore with an injury-time winner; Ancelotti and Raphinha sent off
facts: Japan won 3-2 at Singapore's National Stadium in a friendly; Kubo and Keito Nakamura scored early, Vinicius Junior scored twice for Brazil.
Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's deflected shot won it in injury time.
Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were sent off after protests over a disputed foul.
It avenged Japan's 2026 World Cup knockout defeat to Brazil.
background: Ancelotti took the Brazil job in May 2025; Japan had never won a World Cup knockout match.

headline: Moriyasu's eight-year Japan reign ends after Paraguay friendly
facts: Moriyasu's final game in charge was set against Paraguay at Singapore's National Stadium on 17 November.
He lifted Japan from 55th to 17th in the FIFA rankings over eight years.
He never delivered a first World Cup knockout win; Japan lost 2-1 to Brazil in 2026, conceding in the 95th minute.
The article names no successor and gives no reason for his exit.
background: Moriyasu took over after the 2018 World Cup.

headline: Vinicius hits a first-half hat trick as Brazil crush Singapore 7-0
facts: Brazil won 7-0 in Singapore, with Vinicius scoring at 9', 15' and 21'.
Endrick, Estevao and Rayan also scored, plus a Singapore own goal.
Ancelotti watched from the stands because of his red card against Japan.
It was Ancelotti's biggest win since taking over in May 2025; Singapore are ranked 148th.
background: Brazil are five-time world champions; this was their first-ever meeting with Singapore.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior hat trick Brazil Singapore

headline: Nations League quarterfinal draw: England-Norway, Spain-France, Netherlands-Portugal, Belgium-Germany
facts: First legs are 25-27 March and second legs 28-30 March; finals weekend ends on 13 June.
England vs Norway repeats a World Cup quarterfinal England won 2-1 with two Bellingham goals.
Spain vs France repeats the World Cup semifinal.
Tuchel says the Nations League is good Euros preparation but the quarterfinal comes first.
background: Spain beat France in the 2026 World Cup semifinal and then Argentina in the final.
footage_terms: England Norway World Cup quarterfinal highlights
Spain France World Cup semifinal 2026 highlights

headline: England beat Spain 3-2 in Madrid, ending Spain's 43-game unbeaten run
facts: England won 3-2 in Madrid: Kane penalty, then Konsa and White after the break; Oyarzabal and Nico Williams replied.
England led 3-0 before Elliot Anderson was sent off in the 63rd minute for fouling Lamine Yamal.
It ended Spain's 43-game unbeaten streak and their first home loss in over four years.
Tuchel called it the best result of his England tenure; England top Group C.
background: Spain are the reigning world champions, having beaten Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final.

headline: UEFA hands England a suspended away-ticket ban and 15,000 euro fine for fan chants in Madrid
facts: UEFA cited racist and/or discriminatory behaviour at the 3-2 win over Spain in Madrid.
The ban on selling tickets for one away match is suspended for two years; the FA was fined 15,000 euros.
Reports say the chants were anti-Catholic and anti-Irish; the Free Lions fan group condemned them.
Free Lions warned continued chanting could cost fans future away games.
background: The sanction followed the 3-2 win in Madrid on 15 November, which sent England top of Nations League Group C.

headline: Haaland's 96th-minute penalty sends Norway past Denmark 3-2 into the Nations League quarterfinals
facts: Norway beat Denmark 3-2 after trailing by two goals.
Haaland scored twice, including a VAR-awarded penalty at 95:45, the latest goal of his Norway career.
Norway finished second in Group A4 under Stale Solbakken.
Haaland now has 68 international goals.
background: Norway reached the 2026 World Cup quarterfinals, where England beat them 2-1; Haaland has now scored 68 goals for his country.

headline: Klopp's Germany smash Netherlands 5-0 to top Nations League group, Wirtz scores twice
facts: Germany won 5-0 and took Nations League Group A2 and a top seed for the quarterfinals.
Wirtz scored twice, including a long-range strike in the 60th minute and a volley in the 71st.
Klopp said the result would quiet doubters for three or four months.
He took over in August after Julian Nagelsmann was dismissed following a Round of 32 World Cup exit to Paraguay.
background: Klopp previously managed Borussia Dortmund and Liverpool before returning to take the national team job.

headline: Klopp says FIFA is worse than in Blatter's day and hopes Infantino is replaced
facts: Germany coach Klopp said he hopes Infantino is replaced and that FIFA has become worse since Blatter.
Infantino was criticised over the handling of USA striker Folarin Balogun's red card at the World Cup.
He also faced backlash for a proposed 20 billion dollar World Cup company with private investors.
The election is on 18 March 2027 in Rabat; UEFA was seeking a candidate before an 18 November deadline.
background: Infantino has led FIFA since 2016, and this will be his first contested election.

headline: Lukaku retires from Belgium as all-time top scorer with 94 goals
facts: Lukaku retired after a 16-year international career with 94 goals in 135 caps, a Belgian record.
Kevin De Bruyne is second with 41; only Ronaldo, Messi, Ali Daei and Sunil Chhetri have more international goals.
He scored eight goals at the 2026 World Cup, a Belgian tournament record.
His last appearance was a 4-1 loss to France last month; he was an unused sub in a 4-1 win over Italy.
background: The article links the exit to an injury-hit few years.

headline: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or and sets sights on Champions League and an England trophy
facts: Kane won the Ballon d'Or last month ahead of Mbappe and Yamal.
He captained England to third at the World Cup, their best finish since 1966, with six goals in seven games.
He scored 61 goals for Bayern in all competitions, including 36 in the Bundesliga.
He says the Champions League is the main goal this season and still wants a major trophy with England.
background: Kane lost the 2019 Champions League final with Tottenham against Liverpool and has never won a major international trophy.

headline: Salah becomes Egypt's all-time top scorer with a Panenka penalty
facts: Egypt beat Malawi 5-0 in an AFCON 2027 qualifier.
Salah scored twice: an 84th-minute goal tied Hossam Hassan's record, then a chipped penalty in added time passed it.
His second goal took his Egypt total to 70.
The article does not name Egypt's coach.
background: Hossam Hassan was Egypt's previous record scorer, a striker of the 1990s and 2000s.

headline: Scotland thrashed 4-0 by Switzerland as pressure builds on Pocognoli
facts: Scotland lost 4-0 in St Gallen: a Lewis Ferguson own goal (22') then goals from Boteli, Sanches and Amdouni.
Scotland finished third in Group B1 on seven points from 18, missing the promotion play-off and a better Euro 2028 qualifying seeding.
Pocognoli has won only twice in six games, both against North Macedonia.
Andy Robertson became Scotland's most-capped player with his 103rd cap, passing Kenny Dalglish.
background: Pocognoli replaced Steve Clarke in August; Dalglish had held the Scotland caps record for decades.

headline: McGinn says it is impossible to claim Scotland are heading in the right direction
facts: Aston Villa's McGinn said it is impossible to argue Scotland are on the right track under Pocognoli.
Scotland have beaten bottom side North Macedonia twice in six games under him.
Pocognoli says the 4-0 scoreline overstates how the game went.
McGinn was among those who missed first-half chances.
background: McGinn is Aston Villa's midfielder and a long-time Scotland regular; Pocognoli replaced Steve Clarke in August.

headline: Ireland beat Kosovo 3-0 to reach Nations League play-offs, then draw Croatia
facts: Ireland were drawn against Croatia in the promotion play-off: first leg in Dublin on 27 March, second leg away on 30 March.
Ireland beat Kosovo 3-0 at the Aviva, with Troy Parrott scoring twice and Jack Moylan once.
The win secured pot-two seeding for the Euro 2028 qualifying draw, with Ireland as co-hosts.
Other play-offs: Bosnia v Denmark, Hungary v Serbia, Slovenia v Wales.
background: Croatia were 2018 World Cup finalists; the sides last met at Euro 2012, when Croatia won 3-1.
footage_terms: Ireland Croatia Nations League play-off draw

headline: Kosovo fined 42,250 euros after fans whistle Israel's anthem and show discriminatory behaviour
facts: UEFA fined the Kosovan FA 42,250 euros after the goalless Nations League game with Israel in Pristina on 14 November.
Charges included whistling the anthem, racist and discriminatory behaviour, thrown objects and an unsuitable message broadcast.
A partial stadium closure was suspended for two years.
Kosovo had similar fines after home games against Ireland and Austria.
background: Kosovo have repeatedly been sanctioned for fan behaviour in this Nations League campaign.

headline: Northern Ireland draw in Hungary to win promotion to the Nations League top flight
facts: Northern Ireland drew 1-1 in Budapest after Varga's opener; Justin Devenny equalised in the 65th minute.
They finished unbeaten and one point above Hungary in Group B2.
Michael O'Neill watched from the stands on a touchline ban while Steven Davis relayed instructions.
They had conceded no goal in the campaign until Varga's strike.
background: Northern Ireland were promoted from League C only two years earlier.

headline: Marquez finally wins as Mexico coach, edging Jamaica on away goals after a five-game winless run
facts: Mexico beat Jamaica 1-0 in Monterrey (Jesus Corona, 35') after losing the first leg 3-2; they advanced on away goals.
It was Marquez's first win as manager after a 0-3-2 start; he made five changes.
The win also clinched a place in the 2027 Gold Cup.
Mexico face the United States in the Nations League semifinal in late March at SoFi Stadium.
background: Marquez, the former Barcelona defender and an ex-assistant, took over from Javier Aguirre.
footage_terms: Mexico Jamaica Nations League highlights Corona

headline: Socceroos lose 2-0 to Jordan in Doha after Amman fixture moved over security fears; Popovic's future unclear
facts: Jordan won 2-0 in Doha through Al-Taamari and substitute Ali Olwan.
The game was moved from Amman after players followed government travel advice (reported 12 November).
Popovic called the first half very poor; Daniel Arzani was sent off late.
It may be Popovic's last game unless he agrees a new Football Australia deal.
background: Popovic said players who opted out over travel fears would not be punished in selection.

headline: Nigeria draw 0-0 in Tanzania and are close to missing AFCON 2027
facts: Nigeria drew 0-0 with Tanzania in Zanzibar and have 7 points from four Group L games.
Tanzania qualified as co-hosts, leaving one place among Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau and Madagascar.
Nigeria need to win both March games, including by four goals against Guinea-Bissau.
Chelle made seven changes and played Arokodare and Awoniyi up front without Lookman.
background: Nigeria have won only two of their last nine away qualifiers and have not scored in either away game this campaign.

headline: Mosimane's South Africa beat Kenya 2-1 as Mofokeng scores both
facts: South Africa won 2-1 in Nairobi in AFCON 2027 Group D qualifying.
Relebohile Mofokeng scored both goals, the second late.
South Africa had drawn 2-2 at home with Kenya on the Friday and Mosimane was criticised for not starting Mbokazi.
Kenya co-host AFCON 2027 with Tanzania and Uganda.
background: Mofokeng moved to Union Saint-Gilloise from Orlando Pirates; Mosimane is back as Bafana Bafana coach.

headline: FIFA election: Tashima and Diallo may unite against Infantino, Tashima cites the Balogun red-card saga
facts: Tashima, ex-Japan FA president, says he is open to working with France FA boss Diallo against Infantino's fourth-term bid.
The election is on 18 March; Infantino has AFC and African backing, and an unofficial AP tally put him at 105 of the 106 votes needed.
Tashima told RTE he was angered by FIFA suspending Balogun's automatic one-match ban at the World Cup in July.
He has no continental confederation nomination and Diallo is backed by UEFA.
background: Infantino has led FIFA since 2016; this will be his first contested election.
footage_terms: Balogun red card FIFA World Cup USA Belgium

headline: Judge rejects FIFA bid to block UEFA from World Cup stake-sale documents
facts: UEFA's Ceferin and other FIFA council members demanded a full response on documents about the failed 20 billion dollar plan to sell World Cup commercial rights.
FIFA said UEFA must accept strict review protocols at its Zurich office before seeing key documents.
On 12 November a Manhattan judge rejected FIFA subsidiaries' bid to block UEFA's evidence requests to Thrive and JP Morgan.
The aborted deal offered 4.2 billion dollars for a 20% stake in FIFA's tournament unit and 20 million dollars to each of 211 federations.
background: The plan was dropped after global backlash, and UEFA is also reported to be preparing a Swiss criminal complaint.
footage_terms: UEFA FIFA World Cup stake sale Infantino
FIFA investors Thrive Kushner World Cup

headline: Palace boss Thomas Frank is fine with McCarthy doubling as Ireland first-team coach
facts: Thomas Frank was appointed Crystal Palace manager on 16 November after Pierre Sage was sacked.
Assistant Paddy McCarthy also works as Ireland's first-team coach and Frank is keeping that dual role.
McCarthy missed an Ireland recovery session to join Palace in London, then flew back to watch Ireland beat Kosovo.
Frank said there is no problem with the arrangement.
background: McCarthy is a retired centre-back and Palace club legend.
footage_terms: Thomas Frank Crystal Palace appointed press conference

headline: Declan Rice hits back at Souness who called him limited
facts: Souness had said in the summer that Rice was limited and maybe better as a centre-half.
Rice told The Independent that football is different now from Souness's era but he would still shake his hand.
He cited Kane dropping deep next to Arsenal centre-backs in a 2-2 Champions League draw with Bayern as proof the game evolved.
Rice also called his World Cup form average by his own standards; England lost to Argentina in the semifinal and finished third.
background: Rice was a key part of Arsenal's recent Premier League title win.

headline: USMNT drops out of ESPN's top-15 World Cup 2030 power rankings as Spain stay No. 1 and Germany jump four places
facts: ESPN's 20-voter panel has Spain first with 15 first-place votes, England second and France third.
Germany rose four places to fourth after the 5-0 win over the Netherlands.
The US fell out of the top 15 as voters worried about life after Pochettino.
Spain stay No. 1 despite their 43-game unbeaten run ending against England.
background: The next World Cup is in 2030; Argentina will co-host as one of the opening-match hosts.
footage_terms: World Cup 2030 power rankings Spain England
